titulo: A yellow note on the recipe card: pinch
caption:
A yellow note on the recipe card: pinch

The soup came out too salty. The recipe card got a yellow note that said pinch.

A note on the card takes five seconds, and the next batch starts one step ahead of this one.

For whoever writes the fix on the recipe while it's fresh.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a long counter. On it a recipe card titled Soup with three ticked boxes and one empty line, and a pot with steam at the right. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans in and a yellow note that says pinch drops onto the card, with a small sparkle above it. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me writing down the fix.
